I've been following this story in my news feed and it's certainly been a confusing one. Green Man Gaming provided an update today that they'd be listing the sources for keys that you buy moving forward, but I'm not sure they can shake the uncertainty that they've surrounded themselves in with this news.

Green Man Gaming now lists where game keys were obtained - VG247

Steam does a lot for PC gaming: from pushing linux, to helping devs with greenlight, to doing a good job with classics like CS and Dota. Sometimes they make mistakes but overall Steam makes PC gaming better. Same goes for GoG, they don't just sell games, they have a mission, they take care of older games, and they make PC gaming better as well. Everyone else just sells games, so I prefer to support Steam and GoG, even if it means I pay a few bucks extra sometimes.

Some publishers have chosen not to do business with GMG. GMG chose to purchase keys for reselling from other businesses who have contracts to buy and resell keys from those publishers. As long as no contracts for buying and reselling were violated then it is not an issue. The publishers still get their money through whichever of their authorized resellers chose to sell keys to GMG.

I love how they keep saying gray market. Calling it a gray market makes it sound like what they are doing is illegal. As long as there is no contract in place a reseller can usually purchase from whomever is willing to sell to them knowing they intend to resell it. The publisher can deny selling to GMG directly but to prevent GMG from purchasing keys from an authorized reseller they would need to change their contracts with those authorized resellers. It doesn't make those keys any less legal.

Edit: As for the invalid keys and other issues, I would have just contacted GMG customer support and see what they said. I've had times at work with being given the wrong activation key because someone had never checked that the one we bought was already given out and activated. I contacted that reseller and had a new activation key within an hour.
